title: Senior Executive at Advisory Firm Believes QuickBooks Will Maintain SMB Accounting Share as Clients Grow More Complex
expert: Partner and CFO, advisory firm with 55 active SMB/mid-market clients (current)
verdict: Intuit-related activity and QuickBooks usage at this 55-client advisory firm rose 5%-10% y/y as 9 in 10 new clients chose QuickBooks, but the expert sees 2026 flat and thinks only 1%-5% price increases would be accepted.

Paid-customer and platform growth vs 13-: 🟢 **Intuit activity and QuickBooks usage +5%-10% y/y** on new-client wins; above company online paid-customer growth of +3% (SB #48888). → Tenet 2 (core funnel) ↑ [4 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269384&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse9302&hl=fse9302,fse10058,fse10959&page=2)

🟢 **9 in 10 new clients choose QuickBooks**, setup in less than a day; firm adds 1 to 2 clients a month. → Tenet 2 (core funnel) ↑ [8 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269384&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse6958&hl=fse6958,fse14911&page=2)

🔴 **Activity flat in 2026 vs 2025 (estimate)**; first read on this outlook. → Tenet 2 (core funnel) ↓ [17 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269384&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse14850&hl=fse14850,fse15302&page=2)
Pricing and ARPC (Tenet 2): 🔴 **1%-5% price increase acceptable (estimate); over 5% would surprise**, vs 2026-08-01 list increases of +13%/+22%/+24% (thesis page): **conflicting**. → Tenet 2 (pricing) ↓ [18 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269384&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse20095&hl=fse20095,fse20364&page=2)
Competition and retention (Tenet 5): 🟡 **Migrations balanced**: complex clients leave for NetSuite or Sage Intacct; Campfire wins AI early adopters; AI only incremental. → Tenet 5 (disruption contained) → [6 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269384&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse11334&hl=fse11334,fse11396,fse11550,fse11665&page=2)

changes: Activity/usage +5%-10% y/y (first-hand) vs company online paying customers +3% y/y at 8.9M (SB #48888): stronger in this channel.
Acceptable price increase 1%-5% (estimate) vs 2026-08-01 QBO list increases of +13% to +24% (thesis page data point): conflicting.
Balanced migrations incl. Campfire vs Cleveland noting Digits, Puzzle and Campfire gaining SMB traction (thesis page, 2026-07-09): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (core funnel and pricing): → — 9 in 10 new clients choose QBO and usage +5%-10%, but tolerance of only 1%-5% price increases sits well below the August list moves.
Tenet 5 (disruption contained): → — balanced migrations; Campfire named for AI early adopters, no share figure.
Tenet 1 (mid-market): ↓ — complex clients graduate to NetSuite/Sage Intacct rather than IES (no number).
